Here’s a polished version you can send:

:::writing{variant="email" id="48217" subject="Urgent Event Day Update: Entry & Security Information"}
Hi everyone,

**Urgent update for event day tomorrow!**

All attendees will be asked to enter through either the **Front Entrance** or the **South Entrance** in order to proceed through the **Evolv security scanners**.

Please note that **bags may be checked for security purposes**.

Attendees may park in **any available parking lot** and then proceed to one of the designated entrances listed above.

We look forward to having you with us and can’t wait to see you tomorrow!

Best,  
Bethany
:::
